objects.query: SELECT Name, Status, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE Name IN ('One-Time', 'Evergreen Monthly', 'Term Annual') ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC
SELECT StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Code FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code LIKE 'ATTR-VEL-%' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Name, IsDefault, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo FROM CostBook WHERE Name = 'Standard Cost Book'
SELECT Name, IsActive, IsStandard FROM Pricebook2 WHERE IsStandard = true OR Name = 'Standard Price Book'

SELECT AdjustmentMethod, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, IsActive, Name, Pricebook2Id, ScheduleType FROM PriceAdjustmentSchedule WHERE Name = 'Standard Attribute Based Adjustment' AND ContractId = NULL ORDER BY Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC
SELECT Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjRule WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeDefinitionId, BooleanValue, DateValue, DateTimeValue, DoubleValue, IntegerValue, Operator, ProductId, StringValue FROM AttributeAdjustmentCondition WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, AttributeAdjConditionsHash, AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeCount, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, ProductId, ProductSellingModelId, ScheduleType, SellingModelType FROM AttributeBasedAdjustment WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC

SELECT Name, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, CurrencyIsoCode FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, Name ASC

SELECT Cost, CostBookId, CostBook.Name, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, Description, CurrencyIsoCode FROM CostBookEntry WHERE Product.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY CostBook.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
